title: Whatever You Expect Will Never Depress You
text: [Music] your faith is only as strong as the test it survives so no matter how much you brag on how much faith you have the test that you're going through now will prove it and this is why in the body of Christ whenever you make a confession jesus said it must be tested I remember Peter told Jesus I will never leave you I will never forsake you I died for you and Jesus says oh he said Peter Satan has now required you to be tested for the words you said the problem with living in the kingdom of God is this you cannot get things without confessing but when you confess them they will be tested and everybody sometimes people say to you and I I was doing fine until I became a believer and now I'm having all these problems well the reason why I have enough problems is because you have you decided to confess I am following Christ Jesus said anyone who will live godly in christ jesus must suffer but let me read a verse of scripture that we don't claim John 16 verse 1 Jesus said these words he says these things have spoken unto you that you should not be offended when they happen they shall put you out of the synagogue yes the time is coming that whoever kills you would think he's doing God's service these things will they do unto you because they have not known the father know me but these things have I told you before now so that when the time shall come when they happen you remember that I told you that they were coming these things I said not unto you at the beginning because I was with you now what he's saying is look I am Telling You that crisis is coming so I render crisis comes you are not shocked a lot of people are shocked today because they didn't expect the crisis crisis look I'm telling you that crisis coming so when it comes you be offended offended means to be depressed to feel shocked whatever you expect will never depress you
